fields.name: Witness Cross Relaxed Fit Crewneck T-Shirt

Elevate your wardrobe with our impactful "Witness Cross" crewneck t-shirt, designed to make a statement of faith with style and grace. Crafted from a comfortable cotton-blend fabric, this black shirt features bold white text that carries a powerful message.

The word "WITNESS" emblazoned above the word "CROSS" draws attention to the central imagery of a cross formed by the extended vertical line of the letter "T." This clever design serves as a visual representation of Christian faith, symbolizing the act of witnessing to the crucifixion of Jesus Christ and the redemption found in His sacrifice.

With its relaxed fit, short sleeves, and crewneck style, this t-shirt offers both comfort and versatility for everyday wear. Wear it with pride as a testament to your faith, and let it spark conversations about the love and hope found in Christ.

Add a touch of symbolism and meaning to your wardrobe with our "Witness Cross" crewneck t-shirt. Perfect for believers who want to express their faith in a contemporary and stylish way.

fields.name: "Faith Forwarding All Issues to Heaven" T-Shirt
fields.description:
Elevate your faith and style with our "Faith Forwarding All Issues to Heaven" t-shirt, a powerful reminder of where to turn in times of trouble. Crafted from soft, breathable fabric, this blue tee features a unique design where each letter of the word "FAITH" is formed by stacking words that collectively convey the message:

F is made out of the letters "FORWARDING"
A is made out of the letters "ALL"
I is made out of the letters "ISSUES"
T is made out of the letters "TO"
H is made out of the letters "HEAVEN"
Below the stacked letters, the words "Strong &" are written in a smaller font, emphasizing the wearer's strength and reliance on their faith.

This Christian t-shirt serves as a powerful declaration of trust in God's guidance and provision, reminding us to surrender our worries and burdens to Him. Wear it as a source of inspiration and encouragement, knowing that your faith can carry you through any challenge.

Add this meaningful piece to your wardrobe today and let your faith shine through in every outfit choice.

Additional Details:

Available sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL
Made from soft and comfortable fabric for all-day wear
Available in blue color with white text design
Suitable for both men and women
